rumour.jaymoskingdoms.cinder_forge.0: The miners say an old Emberborn keeps a forge in the Nether, a few hundred paces %s of its heart.

rumour.jaymoskingdoms.cinder_forge.3: The monks swear he works his fire with no runes at all. Only those whose eyes are open to ki ever see it.
